propositions: Configuration resolution must establish one immutable, serializable, non-secret OperationSnapshot per operation boundary with precedence: explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, and must not reread ambient state during an in-progress operation.

Authentication composition across LLM, Git, bridge, MCP, review-bot, observability, and op-cert must use provider-native auth injection through existing ProviderSession builders without arbitrary client injection, while static credentials remain provider-specific non-serializable carriers (SecretStr/SecretBytes) revealed only in sending adapters.

An AST ownership gate must derive config and credential names from authoritative registries, reject direct/aliased config reads and backend reloads below approved seams, permit only exact path/symbol+rationale exceptions, and enforce zero legacy exceptions at cutover.

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before service work, copy the key into a process-owned 0700 directory/0600 file, and have no application runtime SSM/boto3/region dependency.

Same-capability children must inherit ambient environment for Git/SSH/AWS/proxy/CA compatibility; owning children receive only their adapter overlay; unrelated sibling children remove exact secret names declared by other Rebar adapters.

Secret material must be absent from repr, equality/hash, serialization, snapshots, fingerprints, caches, provenance, exceptions, logs, output, argv, URL/query strings, subprocess siblings, and CLI/MCP schemas.
